name: Health Policy Minor
intro: This 16-unit minor in health policy provides students with a background in the policy issues and challenges globally, nationally and locally related to quality, cost and access to health care. Students in this minor will acquire an understanding of these issues and the skills required to influence health policy.

courses.title: Health and Health Care in America Today
Introduction to Health Policy and Law
Fundamentals of Health Policy and Management
Healthcare Foundations: Core Concepts and Terminology
